features.title: Vertex manipulator for a quadratic graph
features.behaviorSummary: The vertex-form graph view creates a vertex manipulator tied to h and k. Its drag listener constrains the pointer to the graph, rounds the coordinates to the allowed grid, and writes the two model properties; the quadratic model exposes the vertex form.
learnerActions: Drag the vertex on the coordinate graph
Observe the vertex coordinates and graph shape
changes: The horizontal and vertical vertex coordinates change
The displayed quadratic changes with the vertex
feedback: The graph and equation provide immediate visual feedback
The moved vertex is described after the drag

features.title: Snapping coefficient slider
features.behaviorSummary: GQSlider maps between a coefficient property and its view value, constrains values to an interval, can skip zero, and can snap near-zero values back to zero. It also exposes tick labels and an accessible value text for the slider.
learnerActions: Move a coefficient slider
Compare the coefficient value with the graph response
changes: The selected coefficient changes in discrete intervals
The resulting quadratic model changes
feedback: Tick labels and the value label show the current setting
The graph and equation respond to the coefficient

features.title: Curve-snapping coordinate probe
features.behaviorSummary: The point tool drag listener constrains a probe to the graph bounds, snaps it to a nearby quadratic curve, rounds the displayed x coordinate, and updates the tool position. The point tool node presents the coordinates and also installs keyboard drag support.
learnerActions: Drag a coordinate probe across the graph
Move the probe with keyboard input
changes: The probe position changes along the selected curve
The displayed coordinate pair changes
feedback: The coordinate readout identifies the current point
Snapping to a curve is signaled by the tool state

features.title: Function pipeline slots
features.behaviorSummary: Builder creates an ordered collection of function slots. Each slot contains zero or one function instance, empty slots act as identity functions, and applying the builder runs occupied slots in order while emitting a change event when instances are added or removed.
learnerActions: Place a function into an ordered slot
Apply the pipeline to an input
changes: The sequence of active functions changes
The pipeline output changes when a slot is added or cleared
feedback: The slot state shows whether a function is present
The output reflects the ordered composition

features.title: Draggable function pieces
features.behaviorSummary: FBMovableNode connects pointer dragging to the FBMovable model, tracks drag start and end callbacks, and updates the model position during the drag. FBMovable keeps both the current position and a destination for immediate moves or animation.
learnerActions: Drag a function piece on the workspace
Release the piece at a new destination
changes: The model position follows the pointer
The piece can transition between immediate and animated movement
feedback: The piece visibly follows the drag
Start and end callbacks can update the surrounding builder state

features.title: Function piece insertion and slot relocation
features.behaviorSummary: FunctionNode handles the drag cycle for a function instance: it removes the piece from its current container, finds the closest builder slot on release, and animates it into that slot or back to the carousel. FunctionSlotNode provides the dashed empty-slot visual.
learnerActions: Drag a function piece toward an empty slot
Move a piece from one slot to another
changes: A function instance is inserted into or removed from a slot
Adjacent slot occupants can be relocated when a slot is reused
feedback: The dashed slot indicates a drop target
Animation shows whether the piece entered the builder or returned

features.title: Levelled area-model game screen
features.behaviorSummary: The public simulation wires a VariablesGameScreen with six level image properties, and its query-parameter schema controls which of the six game levels are shown. The image registry supplies the visual level assets used by the game screen.
learnerActions: Select a level in the area-model game
Work through the visual level sequence
changes: The selected challenge level changes
The level-specific visual prompt changes
feedback: The level screen presents a different visual challenge
The game structure separates level progression from screen setup

features.title: Fraction construction lab entry
features.behaviorSummary: The Lab screen mounts a BuildingLabModel with a BuildingLabScreenView, while the Intro screen mounts an IntroModel with an IntroScreenView. The repository therefore exposes a dedicated construction-lab screen alongside an introductory visual screen.
learnerActions: Open the fraction construction lab
Switch between the introduction and lab screens
changes: The active screen changes from introduction to construction workspace
The lab model becomes the state behind the construction view
feedback: The screen navigation identifies the current learning context
The construction view provides the active workspace

features.title: Interactive area-model challenge workspace
features.behaviorSummary: The shared game screen selects a level and transitions into an interactive area-model challenge. The model and view expose the workspace where factor and total inputs are checked, with retry, next, answer, and reset feedback tied to the current challenge state.
learnerActions: Select a level and enter its challenge
Edit factor and total inputs
Check, try again, continue, show the answer, or reset the challenge
changes: The selected level and active challenge change
The area-model input and challenge state update
feedback: The workspace displays the current visual challenge
Check, retry, next, answer, and reset controls respond to the model state

features.title: Draggable fraction construction lab
features.behaviorSummary: The building-lab model and screen connect shape and number panels to fraction pieces in a construction workspace. Panel actions create pieces, position updates keep them in the model, and drag listeners allow pieces to be manipulated and grouped before a reset.
learnerActions: Create a shape piece or number piece from a panel
Drag pieces and form groups in the construction workspace
Reset the constructed fraction arrangement
changes: New fraction pieces and groups are added to the model
Piece positions update as they are moved
feedback: The workspace shows each created piece and its position
Drag and grouping state is reflected in the construction view
